name: Rupture
description: Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your attack power.  Lasts longer per combo point:   1 point  : 88 damage over 8 secs   2 points: 130 damage over 10 secs   3 points: 180 damage over 12 secs   4 points: 238 damage over 14 secs   5 points: 304 damage over 16 secs
